WHY_A_SIDECAR: a file cannot contain its own file digest. OMLDCT01 stored the file digest inside a record under the key FREEZE_HASH, which the master freeze used for a digest of its own content — one label over two quantities. The two are named separately here and kept apart.
FREEZE_CONTENT_HASH_RULE: H.content_digest: canonical digest of the document with its own digest fields and GENERATED_UTC removed
